faq.title: What you need to know.
faq.subtitle: Straight answers to the questions we hear most.

items.q: What is a Digital Growth System?
items.a: It's a system that combines a high-performance website, SEO, AI, automation and analytics to drive predictable growth. Instead of loose pieces, everything works together to attract, convert and retain customers.

items.q: How is this different from a traditional marketing agency?
items.a: An agency usually delivers isolated services. Byte & Brain is a technology company: we build integrated systems, with our own engineering, focused on measurable results rather than one-off deliverables.

items.q: What is AI SEO and why does it matter?
items.a: AI SEO is optimization for AI engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. More and more people ask AI assistants questions instead of searching Google. AI SEO ensures your business is cited and recommended in those answers.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: The technical foundation and first conversions can appear in weeks. Organic SEO compounds over 3 to 6 months — and keeps growing. A well-built system generates traffic and authority for years.

items.q: Do you work with my industry?
items.a: Yes. We work with SMEs in construction, clinics, law, accounting, real estate, tourism, industry, e-commerce and B2B services. The system adapts to your context and market.
With a free audit. We analyze your digital presence and show you, concretely, where the growth opportunity is — no commitment.

about.metaTitle: About Byte & Brain — A Technology Company
about.metaDescription: Byte & Brain is a technology company from Setúbal, founded in 2025, building Digital Growth Systems for SMEs. Learn our mission and who we are.
about.title: A technology company. Not an agency.
about.subtitle: We build digital growth systems for SMEs — combining engineering, SEO, AI and automation into one system, focused on measurable results.
story: Most SMEs are served by agencies that deliver loose pieces — a site here, some ads there — with no system tying it all together to drive real growth. The result is digital presence without return.

Byte & Brain was founded in 2025, in Setúbal, to change that: to bring the technology that powers the world's biggest products to small and medium businesses — accessibly, transparently and results-first.
about.mission: To create systems that drive predictable growth for SMEs, combining high-performance websites, SEO, AI SEO, automation and artificial intelligence. We don't sell websites — we build growth engines.
about.founderBio: Miguel Lourenço founded Byte & Brain on a simple conviction: SMEs deserve the same technology and engineering rigor as large companies. He works directly with every client, from diagnosis to building the system.

privacy.metaDescription: How Byte & Brain collects, uses and protects your personal data, in compliance with GDPR.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and your rights under GDPR.

sections.p: We only collect data you voluntarily provide through forms (name, email, company and message) and anonymous technical browsing data.
We use your data to respond to contact requests, deliver our services and improve the site. We never sell it.
We may use privacy-respecting cookies and analytics tools to understand site usage. You can manage cookies in your browser.
We only share data with providers essential to delivering the service (e.g. hosting or email), always with adequate safeguards.
You have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us by email.
We apply technical and organizational best practices to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.
For any question about this policy or your data, contact us via the email in the footer.
